title: ENDEX — Saturday 10:00 CAT, Nhamissa Calm, Buzi Line Still Open

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 10:00 Central Africa Time, Saturday 13 February 2027. Nhamissa is calm, HRI movements there are suspended until a phased restart tomorrow at 07:00, and a replacement water treatment unit is cleared to leave the Beira warehouse for tap stand 2. All 64 staff are accounted for, and the Buzi line, the tarpaulin container and the safeguarding complaint are each with a named owner. This ends the exercise.
finalState: Nhamissa restart at 07:00 Sunday: family tokens, two separate lines, women and older people first, complaints desk; water-tablet bridge running at tap stand 2 while the district health team monitors AWD cases (cholera not confirmed).
Cash rumour answered with one cleared message; the safeguarding complaint is with the safeguarding focal point through a confidential channel only.
Roll call 64 of 64; the replacement unit for PWTU-07 is cleared to move from the Beira warehouse.
G-W-01 Buzi still open: tracked as an HRI-owned line against the 07:30 Sunday coverage target if accepted, or as an HCT escalation on Sunday if declined.
Container MSKU 448210-3: INGD waiver still pending, tracked against demurrage from Monday (day 5), with the Dubai and Nairobi reroute options held in reserve.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. That is the end of play. Put down your phones, radios and drafts, and leave your logs and stock sheets on the table as they are. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash. Each role should come back ready to name one strength and one gap.
fields.hotWashMethod: Round-the-table strength and gap: each role names one thing that worked and one gap, measured against the first-72-hours table, movement and incident reporting, flash update consistency and the gap-list rules.
hotWashQuestions: Staff accounting: from the 05:55 roll call of 61 of 64 to 64 of 64, who owned the families, the media and Geneva, and what did national staff (including Dércio and Luísa at Nhamissa) hear from HRI, and when?

Numbers that agree: did the 3W, Flash Update No. 1, the situation message to HQ, the donor statement and the OCHA Sitrep 2 draft all use the Recount 1 stock (2,400 shelter kits, not 3,000) and 212 households reached at Nhamissa, not 600? Where did the old figures survive, and why?
Commitments against real stock: when HRI said yes or no to G-W-01 Buzi and G-S-02 Nhamatanda, which units, staff, access and dates did it actually have, and who signed?
Movements: who approved the Buzi seats, the UNHAS rotations and the Nhamissa suspension under the movement authorization rules, and who decides the restart?
Safe distributions: what would have prevented the 08:40 crowd surge and the cash rumour, and how did HRI keep the safeguarding complaint out of group channels and reports?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect the stock sheets (Recount 1, v3), every flash update and 3W draft, and the movement requests before the break. Check whether any draft used the 2025 Flash Update No. 2 template figures, or named a staff member or the complainant in a shared product. Record which version (A or B) of the G-W-01 outcome the team played.
